questions.scenario: Your school is hosting a mega Winter Fest. How are you contributing to the promotion?

options.text: Going class-to-class during proxy periods, hyping up the juniors, and physically selling the most passes.
Checking which time of day gets the most WhatsApp status views and posting the ticket link exactly then.
Making a hilarious, trending Instagram Reel or meme to make the fest look like the coolest event of the year.
Deciding the overall fest theme, managing the promotion budget, and assigning tasks to the volunteer team.

questions.scenario: You want to convince your strict friend group to go out for a movie and treat. What's your move?

options.text: Constantly talking to them face-to-face, promising them it'll be epic, and not letting them say no.
Comparing Zomato ratings, calculating the per-head cost, and finding the best discount promo codes to show them it's cheap.
Describing the amazing aesthetic vibe of the cafe and sending them funny stickers until they get FOMO.
Planning the entire itinerary, booking the tickets on BookMyShow, and collecting everyone's money in advance.

questions.scenario: You are shopping at Sarojini Nagar or a crowded local market. What is your superpower?

options.text: Arguing with the shopkeeper loudly, acting like you are walking away, and expertly bringing a ₹800 shirt down to ₹250.
Mentally calculating the actual wholesale price of the fabric to figure out the shopkeeper's exact profit margin.
Digging through the massive pile of clothes to find the one quirky, aesthetic, vintage jacket no one else noticed.
Managing your group's total cash budget and guiding your friends to the specific lanes that have the best quality-to-price ratio.

questions.scenario: You didn't do your homework and the teacher is checking notebooks. What is your survival strategy?

options.text: Standing up confidently, looking innocent, and smoothly talking your way out of punishment with a direct conversation.
Quickly calculating the marking weightage of this assignment to see if getting a zero will actually ruin your final percentage.
Spinning an incredibly dramatic, highly entertaining, and convincing story about how the dog actually ruined your bag.
Distracting the teacher by asking a very smart syllabus question to delay the checking and save the whole class.

questions.scenario: You just uploaded a new photo or Reel on Instagram. What do you do right after?

options.text: Immediately DMing the post to 50 friends and forcing them to 'Like, comment, and share bro!'
Checking the 'Insights' tab constantly to track reach, impressions, and seeing if your hashtags are working.
Obsessing over whether your sarcastic, witty caption hits right and if the music transition is perfectly synced.
Looking at your overall profile grid to ensure this new post matches your personal 'brand aesthetic' for the month.

questions.scenario: You are organizing a surprise birthday party for your best friend. What is your main responsibility?

options.text: Personally calling all their friends to invite them and sweet-talking their parents into letting them stay out late.
Creating a Google Form for RSVPs and splitting the Swiggy cake and food bill perfectly to the last rupee on Splitwise.
Designing a stunning digital invite on Canva and planning the most aesthetic, Insta-worthy room decorations.
Overseeing the entire operation—making sure the cake arrives on time while coordinating the 'distraction team'.

questions.scenario: You are trying to sell your old cycle or school books on OLX or society WhatsApp groups. How do you do it?

options.text: Meeting the buyer near the society gate and aggressively negotiating face-to-face to get ₹300 extra.
Researching similar ads, pricing yours perfectly in the middle, and tracking how many views your ad gets daily.
Taking well-lit, aesthetic photos and writing a super catchy description like 'Barely used, mostly slept on!'
Bundling the books with some old guides to make a 'Mega Combo Offer' to clear out your shelf much faster.

questions.scenario: During a heated Gully Cricket or society badminton tournament, what is your role off the pitch?

options.text: Sledging the opponents loudly, hyping up your own players, and getting into the other team's head.
Keeping the strict run-rate or point calculation in mind and telling the captain exactly what the stats say.
Creating a dramatic nickname for your team and making a super cool logo for the team's WhatsApp group.
Collecting all the entry fees, buying the tennis balls/shuttlecocks, and deciding the strict tournament rules before the toss.

questions.scenario: You are participating in a school debate or MUN (Model United Nations). What is your style?

options.text: Delivering your speech with high energy, loud confidence, and dominating the cross-questioning round.
Memorizing exact statistics, GDP growth rates, and factual data points to logically trap your opponent.
Writing the most hard-hitting, emotional, and poetic opening statement that leaves the entire audience speechless.
Forming alliances in the lobby, leading your bloc of students, and drafting the final resolution paper together.

questions.scenario: It's Diwali Mela time in your society and you set up a games/food stall! How do you run it?

options.text: Standing outside the stall, actively shouting out to the walking aunties and uncles, and pulling them in with a smile.
Tracking exactly which item is selling the fastest and dynamically calculating your profit margin every hour.
Decorating the stall beautifully with lights and coming up with a hilarious, rhyming name for your shop.
Deciding what to sell based on what the society lacks, managing the inventory, and telling your younger sibling what to do.

Field_Sales.title: The Ground Hustler (Field Sales / Event Marketer)
Field_Sales.primary_match_text: You are a total people person! You have extreme confidence, love face-to-face interactions, and possess the ultimate power to convince anyone about anything.
Field_Sales.day_in_the_life: Meeting high-profile clients, pitching products in boardrooms, traveling for ground events, and negotiating big deals with your communication skills.
Field_Sales.alternative_match_text: Your extroverted nature and street smarts would also make you an amazing Public Relations (PR) Officer or Real Estate Broker.
Field_Sales.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce or Humanities. Degree: BBA, B.Com, or BA. Next Steps: Gain practical sales experience through internships -> Pursue an MBA in Sales & Marketing.

Digital_Marketer.title: The Growth Hacker (Performance / Digital Marketer)
Digital_Marketer.primary_match_text: You have a brilliant, analytical mind! You understand that modern marketing isn't just talking—it's about numbers, algorithms, consumer psychology, and internet trends.
Digital_Marketer.day_in_the_life: Running massive Google and Meta ad campaigns, analyzing website traffic (SEO), looking at graphs, and optimizing budgets to get the highest clicks and sales.
Digital_Marketer.alternative_match_text: Your love for data and trends would also make you an excellent Data Analyst or Market Research Executive.
Digital_Marketer.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce (with Math is a plus) or Science. Degree: BBA, BCA, or B.Sc in Statistics. Next Steps: Do specialized certifications in Google Ads, SEO, and Meta Marketing.

Content_Creator.title: The Viral Genius (Content Creator / Copywriter)
Content_Creator.primary_match_text: You are a creative powerhouse! You have an amazing sense of humor, a way with words, and a deep understanding of what makes things go viral on the internet.
Content_Creator.day_in_the_life: Brainstorming funny memes for brands, writing catchy taglines for billboards, scripting YouTube videos, and directing aesthetic photo shoots.
Content_Creator.alternative_match_text: Your storytelling skills and visual aesthetics would also make you a brilliant Journalist, Film Director, or UI/UX Designer.
Content_Creator.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Humanities or Commerce. Degree: BMM (Bachelor of Mass Media), BA in Journalism, or English Literature. Next Steps: Build a strong online portfolio of writing or video editing.

Brand_Manager.title: The Visionary Boss (Brand Manager)
Brand_Manager.primary_match_text: You are a natural leader with a big-picture mindset. You don't just want to create one ad; you want to build an entire brand's identity from scratch and manage the empire.
Brand_Manager.day_in_the_life: Planning multi-crore marketing budgets, deciding if a brand should hire Virat Kohli or Shahrukh Khan, and managing a team of creators and sales heads.
Brand_Manager.alternative_match_text: Your leadership and organizational skills would also make you an incredible Entrepreneur or Product Manager.
Brand_Manager.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce or Humanities. Degree: BBA, BMS, or B.Com. Next Steps: Crack CAT/XAT -> Pursue an MBA in Marketing from top B-Schools (like IIMs, XLRI, SPJIMR).
